name: Prisma MigrateTroveZap flash-loan callback injection
summary: MigrateTroveZap: onFlashLoan did not validate initiator/params, letting anyone migrate (and re-open with attacker params) other users' troves.
notes: Direct deployment of the vulnerable MigrateTroveZap runtime.
The incident post-mortem reports 3,479.24 wstETH lost across the primary and copycat exploit transactions, worth approximately $12 million.
The post-mortem reports approximate aggregate loss across the primary and copycat exploit transactions rather than exact per-transaction quantities.
